title: Dissertationes duae (De morte Christi tip)
author: John Davenant
edition: Dissertationes duae (Cambridge: Roger Daniel, 1650). Wing D317; ESTC R5446. IA bim_early-english-books-1641-1700_dissertationes-du-_davenant-john-bp_1650. Tip: De morte Christi Cap. 1 origin + Thesis 1.
blurb: John Davenant — opening of Dissertation on the Death of Christ from the 1650 Cambridge Latin. Tip covers Cap. 1 controversy-origin and Thesis 1 only; the rest of Dissertationes duae remains.
era_note: Davenant wrote in the early seventeenth century as Lady Margaret Professor at Cambridge and Bishop of Salisbury; he was a British delegate at Dort. This is not a patristic work. It is a public-domain Latin Reformed retrieval on the same Fathers-site pipeline. Do not treat the site as ante-Nicene only.

text_history.method: English follows the locked 1650 Cambridge Latin of De morte Christi Cap. 1 tip (origin + Thesis 1), reconstructed from the Internet Archive OCR of the Roger Daniel folio. The same OCR was used as a check of the reconstruction. The 1683 reprint was not used as copy-text. No modern English was copied.
